Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4495582. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL4495582, require exact activity values (standard_relation '=' and standard_value not null), join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
